title: Risk-calibrated compliance needs scorer and SLA bundler for enterprise intake
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Large enterprise customers submit diverse security and compliance asks (SOC2/ISO artifacts, DPA variations, HIPAA, and long vendor questionnaires). The triage burden falls on SRE/PM/CS teams and leads to inconsistent SLAs, duplicated evidence collection, and missed commercial signals.

Goal: Build a deterministic scorer that classifies incoming security/compliance requests by risk, evidence complexity, and commercial priority, then surface an SLA bundling recommendation (self-serve, concierge, expedited) and a targeted evidence checklist. The system should reduce manual triage time by 60% and improve SLA adherence for high-value customers.

Scope: Ticket covers PM work to define scorer features, business rules, customer-facing SLA tiers, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for pilot with Customer Success. Engineering and Design tickets will follow. Excludes automated document assembly (future work).
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic scoring rubric is documented with weightings for risk, customer value, and evidence complexity
SLA bundling matrix covering at least three lanes (self-serve, standard 10-day, expedited 48-hour) is agreed and documented
A sample dataset of 250 historical requests is annotated and used to validate the scorer with >=85% top-lane alignment vs. SME labels
Customer Success pilot is planned with 3 customers and success metrics defined
Operational handoff doc for Support/CS with playbooks for each SLA lane exists in Confluence (link in comments)
metrics: Triage time per request (median) - target: 40% reduction in pilot
SLA adherence rate for high-priority lane - target: 95%
Percent of requests auto-assigned to correct lane by scorer - target: 85%
CS satisfaction score on triage quality (NPS-like) - target: 8/10
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Scorer misclassifies edge-case legal asks -> Mitigation: human-in-loop for first 90 days and a rapid feedback channel to update weights
Risk: Customers perceive expedited lane as chargeable or unfair -> Mitigation: clear communication templates and criteria; pilot with existing enterprise customers
Risk: Data residency constraints in evidence collection -> Mitigation: flag DPA/region in scorer and route to Private onboarding flow
proposed_approach: 1) Define feature set and weights with SMEs (Legal, Security, CS). 2) Curate historical requests and annotate labels (lane, evidence items, severity). 3) Implement a rule-weighted scorer MVP (transparent rules rather than ML first) and an API contract for engineering. 4) Create SLA bundling page in Console for CS to select/override lanes. 5) Run 4-week pilot and iterate on weights.
